SparkR / SPARKR-198
Add a health check from SparkR backend to R process
Change By: Shivaram Venkataraman

This is related to SPARKR-185 and is intended to ensure that the backend always exits when the R process exits.

The proposed solution is to open a server socket on the R side and then have the Java process send periodic heart-beats to this socket. 

Note: We don't need this for the spark-submit case because the JVM comes up first there and exits when the child R process exits.

SparkR / SPARKR-198

Issue Type: Improvement
Assignee: Unassigned
Components: R JVM Bridge
Created: 11/Feb/15 8:38 AM
Environment:

This is related to

SPARKR-185 and is intended to ensure that the backend always exits when the R process exits.

The proposed solution is to open a server socket on the R side and then have the Java process send periodic heart-beats to this socket.

Note: We don't need this for the spark-submit case because the JVM comes up first there and exits when the child R process exits.
Priority: Major
Reporter: Shivaram Venkataraman
